ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-04-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for change of name for 4 minors this day.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Valerie Papale.
Anthony D. Agpaoa, Esq. for Petitioners: Esperanza Sanchez and Hector Sanchez, present with Spanish Interpreter Christina Llop.
Parties were sworn and examined.
The Court grants decree changing of minor's name to: Hector Manuel Sanchez-Garcia.
and grants decree changing of minor's name to: Leticia Sanchez-Garcia,
and grants decree changing of minor's name to: Blanca Esmeralda Sanchez-Garcia,
and grants decree changing of minor's name to: Yesenia Sanchez-Garcia.
Order signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-04-2003 Reset To Dec-04-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley.
Anthony Agpaoa, Esq. for Petioners, failed to provide Proof Of Publications and request a continuance to Dec. 4, 2003 at 09:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
The Court granted the request.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-28-2003 Reset To Nov-04-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Dave Davenport.
Anthony D. Agpaoa, Esq., for petiioners Hector Sanchez and Esperanza Sanchez, present as the guardian ad litem for the minors.
No proof of publication filed.
At plaintiff's request, this matter is continued to Nov. 4, 2003 at 09:00 am. for plaintiff to submit the proof of publication.
